race.comment: Wide-open maiden decimated by scratchings. FORWARD HO (5) returned from a three-month break at Kilmore over 1100m on September 13, finishing third. Placed second-up last time in and drawn to give a sight off a nice draw. I AM ALGADON (9) is a first-starter by I Am Immortal who was an AUD $ 60,000 (Inglis 2025 JANUARY (Late) Online Sale) purchase. Runner-up in a Sandown-Hillside jump-out on September 10. Monitor the markets for any confidence. SNITZEL TYCOON (12) is racing well and, although without a win, has been in the money four times from four races. Last start was beaten narrowly when second over 1200m at Wodonga. Include. FULLY FUNDED (6) returned from a spell with a sound third last start over 1000m at Echuca. Fitter and in the mix.
